name: CASA JMSB
description: CASA is the undergraduate student association of the John Molson School of Business, representing over 7,000 students. It runs academic support and student services, oversees 16 associations and committees, and organizes more than 100 events a year, from networking workshops and Wellness Week to the Halloween party and the 8REWSKI ski trip.

name: JMAS
description: JMAS is the student association for accounting students at JMSB. It connects students with the CPA Order, accounting firms, faculty and each other through info sessions, firm seminars, CPA for a Day and its annual Industry Cocktail.

name: FISA
description: FISA is the student association for finance students at JMSB. It helps students prepare for finance careers through conferences like Careers in Finance, Excel and valuation workshops in its Academic Series, firm tours, networking cocktails and case competitions.

name: JHMA
full_name: John Molson Human Resources and Management Association
description: JHMA is the student association for JMSB's Human Resource Management and Management majors. It runs social and academic events that connect students with industry professionals, faculty and alumni, including workshops, networking nights and the NextGen case competition.

name: JMMA
description: JMMA is the student association for marketing students at JMSB. It organizes workshops, panels and career events, such as portfolio-building workshops and industry panels, to help future marketers build skills and meet people in the field.

name: JSBA
full_name: John Molson Supply Chain and Business Technology Association
description: JSBA represents JMSB students in Supply Chain Operations Management, Business Technology Management and Data Intelligence. It runs case competitions and industry events, including Innov8 with KPMG and the PitchX tech sales competition.

name: JMIBA
description: JMIBA is the student association for International Business students at JMSB. It adds hands-on international experience to the IBUS program through case-cracking sessions, the Nextpatriates Conference and the International Markets Project, a trip abroad (Singapore in 2027).

name: JIC (John Molson International Committee)
description: JIC supports JMSB students going on exchange and exchange students coming to Montreal. It runs info sessions and workshops on going abroad, day trips and social events, and Project Global, a program where students explore Prague and Montreal with international students and compete in case competitions.

name: JMCC
description: JMCC runs JMSB's case competition program, one of the largest in the world. Each year it selects and trains over 150 undergraduate students to represent JMSB at regional, national and international case competitions, and runs internal competitions for students who want to try casing.

name: JMUCC
description: JMUCC organizes the John Molson Undergraduate Case Competition, an international competition held at JMSB every year since 2009. It brings 24 universities from around the world to Montreal to solve real business cases and network with students and professionals.

name: MCC (Management Consulting Concordia)
description: MCC connects Concordia students with management consulting firms in Montreal. It prepares students for consulting careers through academic sessions with firms like Accenture Strategy and mock interviews.

name: Concordia Real Estate Club
description: CREC is Concordia's first real estate club, open to students from across Montreal. It teaches students about the real estate industry through talks, an internal case competition and its annual Real Estate Conference.

name: CASA Cares
description: CASA Cares is JMSB's volunteer and charity committee. It organizes donation drives and volunteer activities to help people in need and to get JMSB students involved in their community.

name: Enactus Concordia
description: Enactus Concordia is the Concordia chapter of Enactus, an international network of students who build social entrepreneurship projects. Members develop community projects that aim to improve the lives of people in need, and the club hosts ID8, an entrepreneurship conference.

name: JMSM (John Molson Sports Marketing)
description: JMSM is for students who want to work in the sports business industry. Its main event is the annual John Molson Sports Business Conference, now in its 30th edition, which brings together students and sports industry professionals.

name: JMWL (John Molson Women in Leadership)
description: JMWL works to engage, educate and empower JMSB students around leadership and gender equality. It runs discussions, campaigns and events like its mentorship program and Ambassador Night to help students build leadership skills.

name: JSEC
description: JSEC is JMSB's sustainable business committee. It works with industry, faculty and students to grow the sustainability community at Concordia and in Montreal, and hosts events like its Sustainable Finance Conference.

name: CASA X
description: CASA X is a team of first- and second-year students under CASA who plan social, academic and charity events for JMSB students. It is known for its monthly 5 à 8s and Thirsty Thursdays, and it recruits 5 to 10 first-year Brand Ambassadors every September.

name: BIA
description: BIA is a JMSB committee focused on how AI is used in business. It runs research, seminars and hands-on workshops like AI Fundamentals and Python sessions, BIA Mondays, and the BIA Case Competition.

name: JMIS
description: JMIS is a group of Concordia students interested in finance and capital markets. Its weekly meetings feature workshops and guest speakers from firms in investment banking, venture capital and asset management, and it runs an analyst program and a pitch conference. Meetings are open to all Concordia students, no experience needed.

name: JMTL
description: JMTL gives Concordia students the chance to learn trading with a market simulator. It is based in the trading room in the MB building and has taken part in competitions such as the Rotman International Trading Competition (RITC).

name: QUARCC
description: QUARCC is a student quant club based at Concordia and open to students across Montreal. Members publish quantitative research, run live paper-trading funds, enter trading competitions and hackathons, and attend workshops and speaker events.
